g.text: MD62 is a thermal-conductivity sensor, not selective to He. Conditioning and gas-specific calibration are mandatory; no factory He accuracy is specified.

g.desc: MD62 is a thermal-conductivity sensor, not selective to He. Conditioning and gas-specific calibration are mandatory; no factory He accuracy is specified.

g.text: 3.0 V +/-0.1 V at the sensor; operating current <=120 mA.

g.desc: 3.0 V +/-0.1 V at the sensor; operating current <=120 mA.

g.text: Enable after HOST_3V3 is valid; disable before the ADC loses power.

g.desc: Enable after HOST_3V3 is valid; disable before the ADC loses power.

g.text: LDO may dissipate 0.24 W. Verify temperature and cable voltage drop.

g.desc: LDO may dissipate 0.24 W. Verify temperature and cable voltage drop.

g.text: Winsen MD62 repurposed for He - constant 3.0 V excitation - calibration-dependent review draft

g.text: 20 SPS normal; IDAC/burn-out OFF; signed data.

g.text: MD62 has no assumed numeric lead order.

g.desc: MD62 has no assumed numeric lead order.

g.text: RN501: matched 2k + 2k; HE_REF = excitation / 2 (1.5 V nominal).

g.desc: RN501: matched 2k + 2k; HE_REF = excitation / 2 (1.5 V nominal).

g.text: No manual trim. Store signed zero and span/curve with known gases.
